## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

HM&FW Department - APMSIDC - Modifications to the RFPs and Draft
Concession Agreements for four medical colleges (Adoni, Markapuram,
Madanapalli, Pulivendula) under PPP mode in Phase-I - Orders - Issued.

HEALTH, MEDICAL AND FAMILY WELFARE (H2) DEPARTMENT

G.O.RT.No. 847

Dated: 02-12-2025

Read the following:

1. G.O.Rt.No.590, HM&FW(H2) Department, Dated:09.09.2025.

2. G.O.Rt.No.197, HM&FW (H2) Department, dated:11.04.2025.

3. Proposal from the MD, APMSIDC, A.P., Mangalagiri, Guntur
District, e-file bearing Computer No.2865475.

******

## ORDER:-

In the G.O. 1ˢᵗ read above, Government have issued orders for
development of 10 new medical colleges at Adoni, Madanapalli,
Markapuram, Pulivendula, Penugonda, Palakollu, Amalapuram,
Narsipatnam, Bapatla and Parvathipuram under PPP mode; and approved
the draft RFPs and Concession Agreements for the development of four
(4) medical colleges at Adoni, Markapur, Madanapalli, and Pulivendula
under PPP mode under Phase-I. The remaining six (6) medical colleges
will be taken up immediately after finalization of the Feasibility Reports,
Draft RFPs and Concession Agreements. The Tender Committee was
permitted to make minor modifications to the RFPs based on pre-bid
consultations.

2.    In the reference 3ʳᵈ read above, the MD, APMSIDC has informed
that two pre-bid consultations held on 06.10.2025 and 23.10.2025. The
PPP Committee constituted vide G.O. 2ⁿᵈ read above, has been met on
13.11.2025 and discussed in detail about the responses to be given to the
pre-bid queries received. The PPP Committee have discussed deliberately
and drafted the responses against each of queries. The Committee have
opined that the following issues requires approval of the Government
before publishing the same in e-procurement platform:

## 1.Allocation of Land for each project

A. The total tentative land to be leased for each site is as below:

i. Adoni - 49.64 acre

ii. Madanapalli - 52.47 acre

iii. Markapuram - 47.10 acre

iv. Pulivendula - 48.50 acre

The site Plans for each site are appended.
